description.p: OxyBrush is an open-source digital sculpting application written in Rust. The model fills the screen, tools appear when you need them, and brushes respond immediately on dense meshes.

ul.li: 16 brushes including Clay, Clay Strips, Crease, Layer, Polish and Topological Move
Alphas, stroke stabilizer, line and stamp strokes
Box and lasso masking and selection
Multiple pieces per document, voxel remesh, merge and decimation
Project files with autosave and crash recovery; OBJ and STL import/export

description.p: This is an early alpha release: expect rough edges.

screenshot.caption: Sculpting with two pieces and a face group

description.p: A Blender bridge sends meshes from Blender to OxyBrush and back, keeping the same Blender objects when their vertices are unchanged. Plugins can run inside OxyBrush in a sandbox, with their own panels. Close holes fills openings in a piece, and an alpha can be captured from the view.

A Tube tool draws a smooth tube along a path you can reshape, for horns, tentacles, tails and cables. The viewport can be lit with up to four lights with soft shadows. Focal shift makes brushes firmer or softer, and S, U, I and O open a slider under the pointer. Cylinder, cone and torus pieces, Split hidden, and a floor grid button were added. Grab no longer leaves jagged seams, and the Windows icon, the log folder, Tab and the brush shelf were fixed.

Dynamic detail adds triangles where you sculpt, so you can build a shape from a plain sphere. The new Curve Move brush bends and stretches a part along a curve you draw. Strokes can be drawn as editable curves. Each piece now mirrors about its own centre, which fixes symmetry on models away from the origin. Tablet pressure works on macOS and in the Flatpak, with a two-point pressure curve. Plugins can read the scene, camera and geometry as data.

Mask extract shows a live preview you can adjust before accepting it. A floor grid under the model follows its size and position. New Pen & tablet settings shape the pressure curve, and on macOS quitting now asks to save unsaved changes.

New Midnight theme: deep navy panels with thin blue outlines and soft shadows, plus a Pill corner style for fully rounded buttons and fields. The Midnight quick preset applies both with the emerald accent and a navy viewport. Documentation brought up to date.

Fixes: the Insert Primitives brush shows the shape growing as you drag, the cut tools show their line and follow symmetry, a moved gizmo pivot stays put, and the Windows Ink pen side button navigates instead of sculpting. Options that used other products' names are renamed, the Matte theme is readable again, and long menus fit on screen.

Mask extract sculpting feature with thickness extrusion and boundary smoothing, C1 smooth symmetry blending for Grab brush, customizable theme presets and accent colors, and high-poly gizmo performance fixes.

Pixar Regularized Kelvinlet sculpting brushes (Kelvin Grab, Kelvin Twist, Kelvin Scale) with elastodynamic volume preservation, and hardware-accelerated real-time wireframe overlay with Shift+W shortcut and opacity controls.
Embedded Python SDK auto-provisioning into user data directory, auto-provisioned bundled example plugins in plugins folder, and standalone script candidate loader.
Python plugin error diagnostic improvements, expanded oxybrush SDK with MeshStats dataclass, bundled mesh stats reporter plugin, and comprehensive GitHub Wiki documentation.

Python plugin and scripting system with pure Python SDK, local AI agent (MCP) integration, keymap editor and navigation presets (MMB orbit), high-res mesh performance optimizations, autosave control, focal length, surface-aligned cursor and custom viewport backgrounds.

Vertex color painting, a transform gizmo for posing, brush presets, glTF/GLB and PLY export with LOD chains and a command-line tool, a command palette and built-in guide, flat shading, custom matcaps and a quick menu at the cursor.
Ambient occlusion and cavity shading in the viewport, faster work with dense meshes (subdivision level changes run in the background), and roughly twice as fast decimation.

Subdivision levels (multiresolution), a friendlier interface with brush, alpha and material previews, Standard, Compact and Touch layouts, arrangeable panels and brush order, and settings that are remembered between sessions.
New brushes (Polish, Planar Trim, Topological Move, Noise), alphas, stroke stabilizer and stroke modes, box/lasso masking and selection, and tester tools (log file, bug-report links).
First public alpha: sculpting core, multiple pieces, voxel remesh, decimation, face groups, project files with autosave, Windows and Linux builds.
